- Integration scope confirmation (API vs. managed connector) — owner: unassigned
- Success criteria for POC (latency, throughput, cost targets) — owner: unassigned
- Procurement timeline & contract path — owner: unassigned

Plan: once we have owners and corrections, I'll compile a consolidated packet and send to Elaine (Acme) + Jason (Procurement) with our proposed owner list and next-steps timeline.
